newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NBS buys Boland banking, financial services.
newsitem.headline: NBS buys Boland banking, financial services.

text.p: NBS Holdings Ltd has acquired the remainder of the banking and financial services of Boland Bank Ltd, the companies announced on Tuesday.

This follows NBS's announcment on December 4 of its acquisition of 25.6 percent of Boland, which prompted analyst speculation that a closer tie-up between the two banking groups would soon be announced.

"NBSH will acquire the entire banking and financial service interests of Boland Holdings, comprising Boland Bank PKS Ltd (a wholly owned subsidiary of Boland Holdings), a 60 percent interest in Boland Financial Services (Pty) Ltd and a 45 percent interest in SMK Securities (Pty) Ltd," the companies said.
NBSH would make the acquitiion in exchange for the issue of new NBSH shares to Boland.
The effective date of the acquisition will be April 1, 1997.
The banking and financial services of NBSH and Boland Holdings have been valued at 6.15 billion rand and 1.84 billion rand respectively.
Details of the acquisition will be announced in due course.
Consideration will be given to the acquisition of further assets by Samgro and/or Boland Holdings to ensure that the companies comply with Johannesburg Stock Exchange listing requirements.

"The acquisition is expected to result in significant benefits for both groups' banking and financial services operations, including an enhanced national branch network, efficient utilisation of the banks' common information technology platform, the sharing of product technology and expertise and the pooling of management resoruces," they said.
The existing management of both NBSH and Boland will not change but a new operational and management structure will in due course be developed, the two companies said.
Samgro Investment Holdings Ltd through Boland Holdings will have effective control of NBSH.
The companies advised shareholders to exercise caution in dealing in their shares and linked units until a further announcement detailing the acqusition has been made.
